annotation.title_clean: 工业和信息化部产业技术基础公共服务平台管理办法
annotation.title_en: MIIT Measures for the Administration of Industrial Technology Foundation Public Service Platforms
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology of the People's Republic of China (MIIT)
named_instruments_referenced: 产业技术基础公共服务平台建设管理暂行办法 (工信部科〔2015〕458号)
annotation.summary_en: MIIT administrative measures (MIIT Ke [2025] No. 261) on the application, recognition, annual evaluation, three-year review and delisting of industrial technology foundation public service platforms. They take effect 5 December 2025 and replace the 2015 interim measures. The excerpt contains no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Eligibility criteria: at least 60% of business in industrial technology foundation services, at least 50 staff, and equipment worth at least RMB 10 million or annual service revenue above RMB 10 million
Recommended platforms are publicly listed on the MIIT website for 5 working days
Platforms submit annual operation reports and undergo a comprehensive review every 3 years
Platforms that fail are given 1 year to fix problems; those that still fail are removed from the list
Effective 5 Dec 2025; repeals the 2015 interim measures (MIIT Ke [2015] No. 458)
